title: AI-Driven Analysis of Menstrual Blood: Diagnosing Endometriosis through Image Processing
summary:
This study explores the potential of menstrual blood (MB) as a tool for diagnosing health conditions, particularly endometriosis. MB contains valuable biological markers that could provide insights into a person’s health. However, MB is often overlooked in medical research. This project aims to collect and analyze images of MB using artificial intelligence (AI) to identify patterns related to health conditions, especially endometriosis.

Participants will be invited to share images of their MB, and a machine learning (ML) algorithm will be developed to analyze these images. The study will also investigate public perceptions of MB through social media analysis and surveys with both women and healthcare professionals (HCPs). By involving citizens in the research process, the project aims to reduce stigma around menstruation, promote menstrual health awareness, and create a non-invasive, accessible diagnostic method for endometriosis.

interventions.name: Online study and interviews with menstruating individuals without diagnosed endometriosis

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Individuals who experience a menstrual cycle without known gynaecological diagnosis
- Individuals who experience a menstrual cycle with gynaecologically confirmed endometriosis
- Individuals who experience a menstrual cycle with suspected endometriosis
- Willingness to accept the consent for participation in the study
Exclusion criteria:
- Individuals, younger than 18 years old and older than 55 years old
- Individuals, who have a different gynaecological diagnosis than endometriosis
- Individuals, who do not experience a menstrual cycle
